title: 第13章  战魔神
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
谢莲心心疼死了呢，她还要去魔界找她娘呢，可不想将她爹的剑气都耗光了。
她母亲是魔尊不假，但魔界很复杂，魔界的巨头不止她母亲一个。明明魔界势力很多，但是每次魔族作乱，所有人都喜欢将事情算在她母亲头上。谁让她名头最响亮呢，最招人恨呢。
被谢莲心一吼之后，回神的众人反应过来，立刻就朝着阵眼飞去，阵法师们一个个加紧修复阵法。但是阵眼几乎都被破坏了，那作为中枢的明月仙珠更是碎成渣了，一时半会儿难以修好。
远方的天空中红云涌动，更多魔族从红云中飞出。魔族铺天盖地地再次袭来了，众人一看，心中慌乱起来。
怎么办现在？
谢莲心的声音回荡在天空中：
“阵法师留下，化神期以上全部出要塞抵御魔族，争取时间。战船全部开出来，化神期及以下守卫要塞。灵子炮全部解封！”
目睹了谢莲心一击杀死百万魔族的场面之后，她的命令很有效果，一下子众人就不慌了。
炼虚期、合体期、大乘期、渡劫期修士们全部飞出了要塞，化神期、金丹期的修士们化为一道道的长虹，尽数落在了一个个炮台上，施法解开了灵子炮的封印。
要塞上每隔百步一个炮台，炮台发射的灵子炮能抵得上合体期修士一击，超大型炮台的灵子炮一击，更是能抵得上大乘期、渡劫期修士的一击。但是每一击都消耗大量的灵石，平日不用的时候为节省灵石出于封印状态，解封需要一些时间。
而现在正好有时间解封，谢莲心争取来的时间。
宋璇落在一处炮台上，跟前悬浮着一只异兽的雕像，他额上都是冷汗，回忆着一次次历练所学，双手飞速地结印，打出一道道的符文禁制。
异象雕像双眼亮起，吐出了一道金色的光芒，那光芒一下子又变成了直径十丈的金色法阵。法阵像是镜子般映照出魔族的身影来，自动捕捉最近的攻击对象，七个魔族被这法阵捕捉，于是七道金色的光束激射而出。
这七道光束绕开了修士，扭曲着击中了魔族。
轰隆隆——
蔓延八千万里的要塞城墙之上，一排排灵子炮次第点亮，金光爆射中，被击中的魔族灰飞烟灭。
与其同时，战船也一艘艘地浮空升起了，船上的灵子炮也全部解封了。修士们祭出各自的法宝，到处都是灵光激射，法宝乱飞。
在找回了节奏之后，魔族被压制了，虽然防御大阵还没修复但是战况是要塞这边站了上风。
然而就在这个时候，一股恐怖绝伦的威压降临了，这股威压让所有人都心脏剧烈地一颤，众人面色煞白，从骨骼中涌出了一股寒意。
修为最高的杜信几个睁大了眼睛，他们朝着天空看去，就见天幕上出现了蜘蛛网状的裂缝，一双长着长长利爪的手从里面伸出来，扒开了一道口子，接着一个青色的头颅挤入进来。

青面獠牙的巨大魔族有着四只狭长的眼睛，眼神充满了暴虐，先是头颅进来，然后是巨大的无比的身体，他整个地进入了此界，怒吼一声，黑色雷暴，仿佛要炸裂苍穹。
魔神级别的威压让天地剧烈的颤抖起来，修士们面无血色，修为低的已经被那一声怒吼中震得直接吐血昏死了过去了。
柳如烟、文婷等也就是因为有各种仙宝护身，这才没晕，但此刻也是吓得已经战都站不起来。莫说他们了，连渡劫期、大乘期的修士们此刻都恐惧万分，开什么玩笑啊，魔神？
魔神居然会出现在了佳孟关？
上一次佳孟关出现魔神还是在八万多年前呢。
防御大阵还没修好，魔神出现了，完了，完蛋了！
青面獠牙的魔神冷冷地俯瞰着众人，魔族们欢呼了起来，魔神那万丈都不止的身体悬浮在虚空中，六只手臂握着各种武器，全身黑气缭绕，散发着不详和邪恶的可怕气息，只是一挥手，数艘战船就被他打爆了。
轰隆隆——
除了少数修士外去，战船上的人全部殒命。
接着他手指一点，一道红光就将杜信这个渡劫期的头给爆了。
“杜师兄！”
众人心胆皆寒，渡劫期的杜信师兄居然就这么没了。
魔神太可怕了！
怎么办？
谁来救救他们啊？
“切！麻烦死了！”
谢莲心啧了一声，这下她至少得再消耗一道剑气了。
她立在天空，全身光华璀璨，她头上多了一根根镶嵌着红色宝石的簪子，胸前多了一个金锁，又挂了一串璎珞，她手腕上多了两个玉镯子，手指上除了拇指，几乎都戴上了戒指或者指环。
她纤细的腰际悬挂着两组美玉，脚踝上也多了几个细细的金环和金铃铛。
她手臂上多了一条白色的飘带，鲲鹏羽衣外面又加了一层罩纱仙衣。

谢莲心将仙宝挂满了全身之后，化为了一道彩色的长虹朝着魔神风驰电掣地冲去，天女们如影随形。
此刻众人都吓傻了，谢莲心和天女们一下子就越过了众人，到了最前面去。
魔族们见谢莲心冲来，立刻也朝着谢莲心这边杀来，黑压压的魔虫一下子到了谢莲心面前。
两个抱着琵琶的美貌天女从谢莲心的左右飞出，戴着指环和手链的修长手指在琵琶弦上一划，随着铮铮的琵琶声响起，一圈圈的青色音波激射而出，将袭来的魔虫群全部击杀。
面目狰狞的夜叉挥舞着铜锤、铁斧，拿着刀枪袭来，身躯巨大的迦楼罗从天空的红云中俯冲而出，摩睺罗伽扭动着巨大的蛇躯，喷出道道血色的红光，妖娆的乾达婆魔女们在虚空中曼舞，舞姿充满了杀机……
天女们纷纷上前，手持各种法宝跟这些魔族激烈地厮杀起来，为谢莲心开道。
砰砰砰——
激战中十几个天女被击落坠毁甚至被打得粉碎，接近魔神的时候，全部天女阵亡。
谢莲心此刻已经到了魔神的眼皮子底下。
她那身体跟巨大的魔神相比，渺小无比，仿佛是海中一叶扁舟，在身躯如同巨岛般的洪荒海兽面前，随时能被碾成碎片。
魔神也没将她这个小不点放在眼中，虽然这个小不点看起来，确实有点意思。他一只手朝着谢莲心抓去，想要将她这个渺小的人类捏成肉酱。
content_en:
Xie Lian was heartbroken. She wanted to go to the Demon Realm to find her mother, but she didn't want to use up all her father's sword energy.
It is true that her mother is a demon king, but the demon world is very complicated, and her mother is not the only giant in the demon world. Obviously there are many forces in the demon world, but every time the demons cause trouble, everyone likes to blame her mother. Who gives her the loudest reputation and the most hateful reputation?
After being yelled by Xie Lianxin, everyone who came back to their senses reacted and immediately flew towards the formation eye. The formation masters stepped up to repair the formation one by one. However, almost all the formation eyes were destroyed, and the Mingyue Fairy Pearl as the center was shattered into pieces, making it difficult to repair for a while.
Red clouds surged in the distant sky, and more demons flew out of the red clouds. The overwhelming demons attacked again, and when everyone saw it, they became panicked.
What to do now?
Xie Lianxin’s voice echoed in the sky:
"The formation masters will stay, and everyone at the God Transformation stage and above will go out of the fortress to resist the demons to buy time. All warships will be sent out, and those at the God Transformation stage and below will guard the fortress. All spirit cannons will be unsealed!"
After witnessing Xie Lianxin killing millions of demons with one blow, her order was very effective and everyone immediately stopped panicking.
The monks in the Void Refining Stage, the Integration Stage, the Mahayana Stage, and the Tribulation Stage all flew out of the fortress. The monks in the God Transformation Stage and the Golden Core Stage turned into rainbows and landed on the forts one after another. They cast spells to unlock the seals of the spirit cannons.
There are forts every hundred steps on the fortress. The spirit cannon fired by the fort can be worth a blow from a monk in the integration stage. A hit from a super-large fort's spirit cannon is even worth a blow from a monk in the Mahayana or Tribulation Stage. However, each strike consumes a large amount of spiritual stones. In order to save the spiritual stones from being in a sealed state when not in use, it will take some time to unseal them.
But now there is just time to unblock it, and Xie Lianxin bought the time.
Song Xuan landed on a fort, with a statue of a strange beast suspended in front of him. There was cold sweat on his forehead. He recalled what he had learned through repeated experiences. He formed seals with his hands quickly and created runic restrictions one after another.
The eyes of the visionary statue lit up, and it spit out a golden light, which suddenly turned into a golden magic circle ten feet in diameter. The magic circle reflected the figure of the demons like a mirror, automatically capturing the nearest attack target. Seven demons were captured by the magic circle, and seven golden beams of light shot out.
These seven beams of light bypassed the monks and hit the demons with twists and turns.
Rumble——
On the fortress wall that spreads for 80 million miles, rows of spirit cannons lit up one after another, and the golden light exploded, and the demons that were hit were wiped out.
At the same time, warships also floated into the air one by one, and all the spirit cannons on the ship were unsealed. The monks sacrificed their own magic weapons. Spiritual light shot out everywhere and magic weapons flew around.
After regaining their rhythm, the demons were suppressed. Although the defensive array had not been repaired, the battle situation was that the fortress side had the upper hand.
However, at this moment, a terrifying pressure came. This pressure made everyone's heart tremble violently, their faces turned pale, and a chill surged from their bones.
Du Xin, the ones with the highest cultivation level, opened their eyes wide. They looked towards the sky and saw a spider web-like crack appeared on the sky. A pair of hands with long claws stretched out from inside, opened a hole, and then a cyan head squeezed in.
The giant demon with a green face and fanged teeth had four narrow eyes, and his eyes were full of violence. First his head came in, and then his huge body. He entered this world as a whole, and roared, a black thunderstorm seemed to burst the sky.
The demon-god-level pressure caused the world to tremble violently. The monks' faces turned pale, and those with low cultivation levels were so shocked by the roar that they vomited blood and fainted.
Liu Ruyan, Wen Ting and others did not faint because they were protected by various fairy treasures, but at this moment they were too frightened to stand up. Don't talk about themWell, even the monks in the Tribulation Stage and Mahayana Stage are extremely frightened at this moment. Are you kidding me, Demon God?
The devil actually appeared in Jiameng Pass?
The last time a demon god appeared in Jiameng Pass was more than 80,000 years ago.
Before the defensive formation was repaired, the devil appeared. It was over, it was over!
The green-faced and fanged Demon God looked down at everyone coldly, and the Demons cheered. The Demon God's long body was suspended in the void, with six arms holding various weapons. His whole body was filled with black energy, exuding a terrifying aura of ominousness and evil. With just a wave of his hand, several warships were destroyed by him.
Rumble——
Except for a few monks, everyone on the warship died.
Then he pointed a finger, and a red light exploded Du Xin's head, which was in the tribulation stage.
"Senior Brother Du!"
Everyone was horrified that Senior Brother Du Xin, who was in the tribulation period, was gone just like that.
The devil is so scary!
what to do?
Who will save them?
"Tch! It's so troublesome!"
Xie Lianxin clicked her tongue, now she had to consume at least one more sword energy.
She stood in the sky, her whole body shining brightly. She had hairpins inlaid with red gems on her head, a gold lock on her chest, and a string of necklaces. She had two jade bracelets on her wrists, and almost all of her fingers, except her thumbs, were wearing rings or rings.
Two sets of beautiful jade hung on her slender waist, and there were several thin gold rings and bells on her ankles.
There was a white streamer on her arm, and a veil of fairy clothes was added outside Kunpeng's feather coat.
After Xie Lianxin hung the fairy treasures all over her body, it turned into a colorful rainbow and rushed towards the demon god with lightning speed, followed by the goddesses.
At this moment, everyone was frightened. Xie Lianxin and the goddesses suddenly crossed the crowd and reached the front.
When the demons saw Xie Lianxin rushing towards him, they immediately attacked Xie Lianxin. The black demonic insects suddenly arrived in front of Xie Lianxin.
Two beautiful goddesses holding pipa flew out from the left and right of Xie Lianxin. Their slender fingers wearing rings and bracelets stroked the strings of the pipa. As the clanging sound of the pipa sounded, circles of blue sound waves shot out, killing all the incoming demonic insect swarms.
The ferocious-looking Yaksha brandished copper hammers and iron axes, and attacked with swords and guns. The huge Garuda swooped out from the red clouds in the sky. Maharaja twisted its huge snake body and sprayed out streaks of bloody red light. The enchanting Gandharva witches danced in the void, their dances full of murderous intent...
The goddesses came forward one after another, holding various magic weapons and fighting fiercely with these demons to clear the way for Xie Lianxin.
Bang bang bang——
In the fierce battle, more than a dozen goddesses were shot down, crashed and even smashed to pieces. When they approached the demon, all the goddesses were killed.
Xie Lianxin was now under the demon god's nose.
Her body was extremely small compared to the gigantic demon god. It was like a small boat in the sea. She could be crushed into pieces at any time in front of the ancient sea beast with a body like a giant island.
The devil didn't pay much attention to this little thing like her, although this little thing did look interesting. He grabbed Xie Lianxin with one hand, trying to crush her, a tiny human being, into a pulp.
